name: Hexpol AB Namn-Aktier B o.N.
summary: HEXPOL AB develops, manufactures, and markets a wide range of polymer compounds, TPE (Thermoplastic Elastomers), and rubber compounds. The company's products are used in various applications, including automotive, construction, and consumer goods, and it is headquartered in Malmö, Sweden. HEXPOL operates globally, serving a diverse customer base with its specialized compounding solutions.
